reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Michael Ramsdell
reviews.text: Howard and Bronson Contractors are the best. Their workmanship is outstanding. The repairs to and painting of our house are gorgeous. Howard also is a man of his word. His quote is the price. There is no nickel-and-diming like many contractors. Finally, when we ran into a problem two weeks after our house was completed (it was unrelated to their work), we called Howard and he sent someone to fix the problem that day. Reliable. Professional. Reasonably priced. Honest. Contractors don’t come better than Howard.

reviews.author: Gina Raynor
reviews.text: I meant to mention, on a previous review written today, that Mr. Howard Bronson was right on top of the work that was being done at our home. He called several times, just to check in with us, to see how things were going and to make sure we were satisfied. Thank you.
